transformation.description: Mask every numerical token in the new disclosure, including table cells, duplicate guidance prose, actuals and year headings. A broad missing-numerical-disclosure control, not an isolated table-parser ablation.

config.selection: Reuse 72 byte-identical v2 synthetic heldout cases and two original supplemental natural withdrawal/rollover cases. B/C use unchanged v8 code; all inputs are exposed regression. No new blind-test claim. Retain frozen uncertain charges and block identical wire requests.

pricing.assumption: Peak rates, all input charged as cache miss; ignore all discounts.

spans.quote: •Q2 revenue grew 16% year-over-year; subscription revenue grew 17% year-over-year
•Revenue: Total revenue was $646 million, an increase of 16% year-over-year.
Subscription revenue was $632 million, an increase of 17% year-over-year.

•GAAP Operating Loss: GAAP operating loss was $19 million, or (3)% of total revenue, compared to a GAAP operating loss of $162 million, or (29)% of total revenue, in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.

•Non-GAAP Operating Income: Non-GAAP operating income was $148 million, or 23% of total revenue, compared to a non-GAAP operating income of $59 million, or 11% of total revenue, in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.

•Cash Flow: Net cash provided by operations was $86 million, or 13% of total revenue, compared to net cash provided by operations of $53 million, or 10% of total revenue, in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.
Free cash flow was $78 million, or 12% of total revenue, compared to $49 million, or 9% of total revenue, in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.
